reason: The cited evidence confirms that refractory HEAs can have BCC structures and good high-temperature strength, but none of the passages specifically addresses the WTaTiVZr alloy, its lattice distortion, dislocation mobility, or DBTT relative to pure tungsten. The key mechanistic premises about dislocation behavior and toughness improvement are therefore unsupported by the cited studies.
premises: Equimolar WTaTiVZr is a single-phase BCC solid solution with high lattice distortion
Lattice distortion in HEAs enhances dislocation mobility
Enhanced dislocation mobility delays brittle intergranular failure and lowers DBTT
WTaTiVZr alloy constituents are reduced-activation refractory metals suitable for plasma-facing components
WTaTiVZr exhibits creep resistance comparable to or better than pure tungsten
